starts.name: docker
starts.stdout:
Front Desk is open, in Docker.
  On this computer: http://127.0.0.1:<port>
  Other devices: put FRONTDESK_BIND=0.0.0.0 in .env (gui/README.md)
  Password, new at each start: <password>
  To keep one, set FRONTDESK_PASSWORD in seats.env (12 characters or more), then run: docker compose --profile frontdesk up -d
Stop it with: docker compose stop frontdesk
